chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Ibn Riʾāb, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:
Regarding a woman, when she dies and there is no woman with her to wash her, he said: “Her husband puts his hand beneath her shirt and washes her up to the elbows.”

key_terms.الْمَرَافِقِ: the elbows; the limit mentioned for the washing
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the deceased woman being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.تُغَسِّلُهَا: washes her; refers to the ritual washing of the deceased
key_terms.زَوْجُهَا: her husband; the one permitted here to carry out the washing
key_terms.قَمِيصِهَا: her shirt or garment; the covering kept in place during the washing
key_terms.مَاتَتْ: has died; the state that initiates the funeral washing ruling

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a woman dies and no woman is available to wash her body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the washing of a deceased woman when no other woman is present to perform the ghusl. It states that her husband may wash her while maintaining covering, by placing his hand under her garment and washing up to the elbows.
